charge_scope: Includes completed-run controller plus entire elapsed first instrumented attempt / debugging / relaunch window, plus observed missing-timer launch wall. Also separately lists subordinate subprocess wall; do NOT add nested clocks. Report writing/model deliberation, initial inspection, and shell inspection commands are not benchmark throughput; no exact all-session CPU measurement exists. This finalization has separate receipt.
memory_scope: OS child-process/descendant maximum RSS, not simultaneous total-container peak. Compiler highest; ODE and per-SSA launch retained separately.
missing_measurement: Exact controller CPU and memory for failed early validation attempt unavailable; entire elapsed interval is conservatively charged, and all its child-process CPU/RSS are retained. First instrumentation failure had no subprocess.
